definition: Sum of official npm download events for November 10 UTC across all 412 cohort packages eligible that day. Fifteen packages first published after that UTC day ended are excluded. Download events include transitive installs and CI; not unique people.
hash_provenance: Stored observation artifact hash is reproducible. Some early point responses have no retained raw response digest; no raw provider digest is invented. Per-response retrieval times are retained where observed; initial partial collection has batch-level time only.
